intro: Scoring runs in Golf Genius. Open your own scorecard, or follow the live leaderboard in your browser.
appNote: Opens the Golf Genius app if you have it installed, otherwise your browser. The code is PRTINV26 if you are asked for it.

notes.label: Format
notes.detail: Two-person scramble net. 35% of the low handicap player plus 15% of the high. Four drives per player minimum. Maximum score was gross double bogey.

rounds.label: Round 2
rounds.leaderboardNote: Round 2 opens Tuesday morning once play is under way. Until then this shows Round 1. Use the round toggle on the page to switch.

notes.label: Format
notes.detail: Two-person shamble net. One tee shot is selected, both play their second from there, then each plays their own ball and the better score counts. Maximum score is net double bogey.

notes.label: Second shot only
notes.detail: You may place within one club length of where the original ball lay, no closer to the hole, and on the same terrain. A selected tee shot in a bunker may be raked after the shot.

notes.label: After the second shot
notes.detail: Play the ball as it lies.

notes.label: Tees
notes.detail: Men play blue, at modified blue and white yardage. Ladies play red.

notes.label: Handicap
notes.detail: 70% of your individual index, as submitted by your captain. No tie-breaker is used.

notes.label: Closest to the hole
notes.detail: Holes 3, 5, 12, 15 and 17. Members only, men and women combined.

notes.label: Shoot-Out
notes.detail: After lunch and scoring, the top three scores and ties play two holes, 10 and 18, for first, second and third.

notes.label: Pace
notes.detail: Four hours thirty minutes or less. Hole out all strokes in contention. The fourteen club rule is in effect.
